# dragonfly_chatbot

An independent DeepSeek Harness support agent for **Dragonfly 3D World** built-in
features. It searc

hes official help and, when available, official Python files in the
user's own Dragonfly installatio
n. It does not claim vendor endorsement.
## Install
Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

At first activation the agent checks the computer for Dragonfly. Windows discovery
checks uninstall

registry entries, standard installation locations, product folders
at drive roots and PATH. DRAGONFL

Y_ROOT / DRAGONFLY_HOME and the `dragonflyPath`
configuration field support custom locations. Detect

ion validates the executable and
product directory structure; it never launches Dragonfly or scans e

ntire drives.
Linux/macOS location discovery is best effort and has not been tested on those systems

tire drives.
Linux/macOS location discovery is best effort and has not been tested on those systems.

**No Dragonfly found:** help-only mode remains fully usable. The agent states this
in its first Drag

onfly answer and every tool response. Run `dragonfly-chatbot doctor`
for a direct report. Reload the
plugin after installing Dragonfly or changing paths.

**Dragonfly found:** help search defaults to its detected version; official Python
source is searche

d in place only when the source tool is called. Multiple versions
remain separate. Unknown or unsupp

orted versions are reported without silently
substituting documentation. You may explicitly request
another documented version.
## Evidence and data

The package contains 525 English help pages for Dragonfly 2027.1.
Chinese queries use bilingual term

expansion; answers can be in either language.
Help citations refer to extracted text lines, not ori

ginal HTML line numbers.
Official notices are retained. See NOTICE.md.

No Dragonfly implementation source, binaries, user extensions or installed Python
packages are distr

ibuted. Only the agent's own code and extracted help text ship.
Local source is read from `python/Or

sPythonPlugins`, `ORSServiceClass`, `OrsHelpers`,
`OrsLibraries` and `ORSModel`; no persistent sourc

e index or source export is created.
Files outside these roots, symlinks, settings and credentials a

re excluded. Compiled
implementations cannot be inspected. Searches have file/byte budgets and repor

t when
truncated; no hit is not proof that an API does not exist.

Evidence returned to Harness enters the configured model context and may be sent to
its model provid
er. Retrieval is deterministic; answer quality also depends on the LLM.
## Tools and configuration

- `search_dragonfly_knowledge`: version-filtered help search.
- `search_dragonfly_source`: bounded r

ead-only local Python search.
- `read_dragonfly_evidence`: read an ID returned by either search.
- `
get_dragonfly_corpus_status`: environment, paths, versions and help coverage.

Configuration: `dragonflyPath` (optional product root/executable), `helpCorpusFile`
(optional additi

onal help-only JSON), `maxResults` (1–20, default 8). Configure these
on the `dragonfly-chatbot` row
in your Harness profile.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Extra 2027.1 help can be imported with `import --root HELP_PATH --source-id my_help
--version 2027.1

--kind help --out help.json`. Product source and other help versions are rejected.
Never publish a
corpus containing locally installed product code.
